why: The engine accepts exactly one dsl_version (ADR-0024). A world document declaring another number — here 0.18.0, the number this surface was written against a change ago — is refused at the envelope, and the refusal names the one number to write. It declares no unit:  is written by every document of the primary, so the field is bound; what this probe demonstrates is that the number is judged, not merely present.
